tickets.subject: Two-factor codes arriving several minutes late
tickets.description: SMS codes take three to six minutes, by which point they have expired. Voice calls arrive instantly.

tickets.subject: SSO login loop for the whole finance team
tickets.description: Finance cannot sign in at all -- the identity provider redirects back to the login page in a loop. Eleven people blocked.

tickets.subject: Checkout returns 500 on card payment
tickets.description: Customers on the Pro plan hit an error at the payment step. Started after this morning's deploy. Three refunds requested so far.

tickets.subject: Password reset link expires too quickly
tickets.description: Links are valid for five minutes, which is not long enough for customers checking email on another device.

tickets.subject: Reports page times out for large accounts
tickets.description: Accounts with more than 50,000 records get a gateway timeout. Smaller accounts load in under a second.

tickets.subject: Export to CSV drops the last row
tickets.description: Any export of more than 500 records is missing the final row. Reproduced on staging with 501 records.

tickets.subject: Search returns no results for hyphenated names
tickets.description: Searching 'Ade-Kunle' returns nothing; 'Adekunle' works. Affects roughly 4% of our customer records.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Dashboard chart is empty on first load
tickets.description: The revenue chart renders blank until you change the date range. Refreshing does not help; interacting does.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries silently dropped since 06:00
tickets.description: Partner integrations report no events received. Our dashboard shows deliveries as successful, so something is failing after the send.

tickets.subject: Bulk import rejects valid postcodes
tickets.description: Postcodes with a space in them are rejected as invalid. The same rows import fine without the space.

tickets.subject: Timezone wrong on scheduled reports
tickets.description: Reports scheduled for 09:00 arrive at 10:00 for users in Lagos. Suspect the scheduler is using UTC.

tickets.subject: Duplicate confirmation emails on signup
tickets.description: New users receive the welcome email twice, about thirty seconds apart. Only on the self-serve signup path.

tickets.subject: API rate limit headers missing
tickets.description: Our documentation promises X-RateLimit-Remaining but the response does not include it, so clients cannot back off.

tickets.subject: Cannot remove a user from a workspace
tickets.description: The remove button is greyed out for users who have been invited but never signed in.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Add a dark theme to the dashboard
tickets.description: Several customers have asked for a dark theme, particularly the support teams who use it overnight.

tickets.subject: Attachments over 10MB fail without a message
tickets.description: The upload spinner runs forever. No error is shown and nothing appears in the console.

tickets.subject: Saved filters disappear after logging out
tickets.description: Filters are saved to the session rather than the account, so they are lost on sign-out.

tickets.subject: Slack integration posts to the wrong channel
tickets.description: After renaming a channel, notifications continue going to the old channel ID.

tickets.subject: Invoice PDF shows the wrong VAT total
tickets.description: The line items are right but the total at the bottom is calculated before the discount is applied.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes when opening notifications
tickets.description: Android only, version 4.2.1. Crash log points at a null title on notifications created before the migration.

tickets.subject: Allow custom fields on the contact record
tickets.description: We need to store an internal account code against each contact. Currently we are abusing the notes field.

tickets.subject: Search index stale after bulk import
tickets.description: Imported records did not appear in search until the nightly reindex. Now reindexing per batch.

notes.author: Tunde Bello
notes.body: Root cause found -- fix in review.

tickets.subject: Export the audit log to CSV
tickets.description: Compliance asks for the audit log quarterly and we are copying it out of the UI by hand.

tickets.subject: Password reset email is slow
tickets.description: Reset emails were taking around twenty minutes. Traced to a backed-up mail queue.

notes.author: Ife Adeyemi
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Keyboard shortcuts for the ticket list
tickets.description: The support team would like j/k to move between tickets, as in their old tool.

tickets.subject: Onboarding checklist never marks itself complete
tickets.description: The final step stays unticked even after the action is done, so new accounts look stalled in our reporting.

tickets.subject: Customers cannot update their billing address
tickets.description: The save button did nothing on the billing form. A validation rule was rejecting valid input silently.

tickets.subject: Bulk edit tags on contacts
tickets.description: Retagging after a campaign takes an afternoon because it has to be done one contact at a time.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Customer data export contained another account's rows
tickets.description: A filter was missing from the export query. Contained, the affected customer was notified, and a post-mortem is scheduled.

notes.author: Ife Adeyemi
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Show the last login date on the user list
tickets.description: Useful for spotting dormant accounts before the annual licence review.

tickets.subject: API returning 401 for valid keys
tickets.description: Keys created in the last hour were rejected. Caused by a caching layer holding the old key list.

tickets.subject: Sandbox environment for integration testing
tickets.description: Partners want somewhere to test against that is not production. Currently they test against live and we clean up.

tickets.subject: Weekly digest sent twice
tickets.description: The digest job ran on both application servers. Now guarded by a lock.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu

tickets.description: Names with accents imported as question marks. The file was being read as ASCII rather than UTF-8.
